declarations.description:
A filter bar: one chip per condition, read as a sentence (`Status | is any of | Active, Paused`), an add-filter
picker, and an editor for each part of a condition. The model of Linear, Airtable and Polaris IndexFilters. Pair it
with `c2-table` or any list.

Describe what can be filtered with `fields` (a property, or JSON in the attribute): each field has an `id`, a
`label`, a `type` (`enum`, `person`, `multi`, `text`, `number`, `date`, `boolean` or `custom`) and, for the choice
types, `options` or an async `loadOptions(query, signal)`. The type picks the operators and the value editor. An
option carries its look as data — `icon` (the tag of an icon element such as `c2-feather-flag`), `color` (a dot),
`avatar` (an image; `person` fields fall back to initials), `description` and `count` — and `renderOption`,
`renderValue` and `renderEditor` on a field replace a row, the chip's value or the whole editor.

The component filters nothing itself. `value` is a plain JSON tree, `{ op: 'and', rules: [{ field, operator, value }] }`,
holding option values only, never labels or colours, so it can be stored as a saved view. Every change fires
`filter-change` with the new tree. A condition still being written (a field picked, no value yet) is shown as a
dashed chip but kept out of the tree, and dropped when its editor closes empty. A nested group in a tree it is given
shows as one removable chip.

Picking a field opens its value editor straight away. Typing in the field picker also matches the options of
every choice field, so "Ana" offers "Assignee is Ana Ng" in one step. On `enum` and `person` fields the operator
follows the number of values: one value is `is` (`eq`), several are `is any of` (`in`). Below `compact-below`
pixels of width, the bar becomes a "Filters" button and a scrolling row of chips; the button opens a bottom sheet
listing the conditions, each editable in place.

cssProperties.description: Border of a condition that has no value yet.
cssProperties.name: --c2-filter-builder__chip__draft--border

cssProperties.description: Text colour of the field part.
cssProperties.name: --c2-filter-builder__field--color

cssProperties.description: Text colour of the operator part.
cssProperties.name: --c2-filter-builder__operator--color

cssProperties.description: Text colour of the value part.
cssProperties.name: --c2-filter-builder__value--color

cssProperties.description: Size of field and option icons.
cssProperties.name: --c2-filter-builder__icon--size

cssProperties.description: Size of an option's colour dot.
cssProperties.name: --c2-filter-builder__dot--size

cssProperties.description: Height cap of a list of options; the list scrolls past it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-filter-builder__popover--max-height

cssProperties.description: Headings, counts and hints in the editors.
cssProperties.name: --c2-filter-builder__muted--color

cssProperties.description: Check mark of a selected option.
cssProperties.name: --c2-filter-builder__check--color

cssParts.description: The row holding the chips, the add button, the clear button and the `end` slot.
cssParts.name: bar

cssParts.description: The wrapping (or, when compact, scrolling) row of chips and buttons.
cssParts.name: chips

cssParts.description: The "Filter" button that opens the field picker.
cssParts.name: add-button

cssParts.description: The "Clear" button shown while there are conditions.
cssParts.name: clear-button

cssParts.description: The surface of the field, operator and value editors.
cssParts.name: popover

slots.description: Content at the end of the bar, such as a `c2-search-field`.
slots.name: end

members.name: fields
members.description: What can be filtered. A property, or JSON in the attribute (without the render and load callbacks).

members.name: value
members.description: The filter tree. Holds option values only. Set it to restore a saved view; read it, or listen to `filter-change`.

members.name: labels
members.description: Interface text, for translation. Partial: missing entries keep the English default.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables adding, editing and removing conditions.

members.name: compactBelow
members.description: Width in pixels below which the bar switches to the compact layout. `0` never switches.

members.name: locale
members.description: Locale of dates and numbers in the chips. Defaults to the browser's.

members.name: nodes
members.description: The conditions on screen, including one still being written. `value` holds the complete ones.

members.name: known
members.description: Options seen so far, per field: static, loaded or resolved. Labels a value whose field loads its options.

members.name: moving
members.description: Set while the popover is hidden only to move it to another anchor.

members.name: resolveUnknown
members.description: Asks `resolveOptions` for the labels of stored values no option list has described yet.

members.name: commit
members.description: The tree of complete conditions; fires `filter-change` when it differs from the last one.

members.name: dropIncomplete
members.description: Drops conditions left without a value when their editor closes.

members.name: moveEditor
members.description: Switches the open popover to another editor, anchored on that condition's value part.

members.name: renderVisual
members.description: The dot, icon or avatar of an option.

events.name: filter-change
events.description: The tree changed: a condition was added, edited or removed. `detail.value` is the new tree (also in `value`). Does not bubble.
